rationale: The material prompt requirement is Production-ready SwiftUI subscription screen with one-time service configuration, localized yearly offering, distinct purchase states, active-entitlement unlock, customer-state updates, restore control, and offline first-launch fallback.. At # Rudder CLI Development Workflow, the source is scoped to Validates, previews, and applies RudderStack resource changes via YAML specs. Use when iterating on RudderStack resources with rudder-cli - validates specs, previews changes with dry-run, and applies changes to workspaces; that scope does not provide a plausible route to the required input/output boundary.
